title: Ardy Lightfoot - Stomach
description:
After weeks of putting off these graphics, I finally decided to create a map16 page and release them. These graphics are seen in Ardy Lightfoot when he gets eaten by the large worm. It takes up a full palette, and quite a bit of map16, but a lot of the tiles are doubles for organization.

So yeah, please credit if used, they were heavily edited by me for convenience.
